presentationPlan.title: Presentation planner
presentationPlan.description: Build a presentation outline from my topic and audience, including the narrative, slide titles, key evidence, visual suggestions, and speaker notes.

spreadsheetAnalysis.title: Spreadsheet analysis
spreadsheetAnalysis.description: Analyze the spreadsheet I attach, explain its structure, find data quality issues and important trends, then recommend useful charts and next steps.

weeklyReport.title: Weekly report
weeklyReport.description: Convert my rough work log into a structured weekly report with completed work, measurable outcomes, risks, next-week priorities, and items needing support.

researchBrief.title: Research brief
researchBrief.description: Research the topic I provide, compare reliable sources, separate facts from inference, and produce a concise brief with key findings and source links.

incompatibleRuntime.title: This system is not supported by the bundled backend
incompatibleRuntime.description: WINK GO opened, but the local WINK GO Core backend cannot run on this Linux version. Please upgrade to a supported Linux distribution and restart WINK GO.

incompleteInstallation.title: WINK GO installation is incomplete
incompleteInstallation.description: This installation is missing required local resources, so WINK GO Core cannot start. Please download and reinstall the latest WINK GO. If the issue returns after reinstalling, check whether security or antivirus software quarantined WINK GO Core.
incompleteInstallation.runtimeComponentDescription: This installation is missing required bundled runtime components, so {{resource}} cannot start. Reinstall the latest WINK GO package. If it still happens after reinstalling, check whether security or antivirus software quarantined WINK GO components.

packageArchitectureMismatch.title: WINK GO package architecture mismatch
packageArchitectureMismatch.description: This WINK GO package is for {{packageArch}}, but this Mac is {{deviceArch}}. You may have downloaded the wrong package. Please download and install the {{expectedArch}} package.

dataMigration.title: Local data migration failed
dataMigration.description: WINK GO opened, but WINK GO Core stopped while initializing local data. Reinstalling WINK GO may not fix this. Send a diagnostics report or contact support so the local database migration can be inspected.

localDataRepair.title: Local data repair failed
localDataRepair.description: WINK GO opened, but WINK GO Core stopped while preparing local startup data such as assistant or agent records. Reinstalling WINK GO may not fix this. Send a diagnostics report or contact support so the local database can be inspected.

startupDirectory.title: Startup directory is unavailable
startupDirectory.description: WINK GO opened, but WINK GO Core could not start because the configured work or log directory is missing, unavailable, or blocked by permissions. Check that the configured directories exist and are writable, then restart WINK GO.

recoverableDatabaseCorruption.title: Local data is corrupted
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.description: WINK GO detected that the local database is corrupted and cannot continue startup. After confirmation, WINK GO will back up the old database and create a new local database to continue startup. Historical local data will not be shown for now, and the old database will be kept as a backup.
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.confirmRebuild: Back up old DB and rebuild new DB
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.diagnosticsHint: Sending diagnostics will not modify the local database.
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.rebuildFailed: Failed to back up old DB and rebuild new DB

transientConcurrentStartup.title: WINK GO is starting up
transientConcurrentStartup.description: Another WINK GO startup was still using the local data when this window opened. This is temporary and your data is safe — no reinstall is needed. Please wait a moment and try again, or restart WINK GO.
transientConcurrentStartup.diagnosticsHint: If this keeps happening, you can send a diagnostics report.
